test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is: **Option (1): NVQ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56e6af09ddd8ad2ccf0054b6b0b1e443fd5762414a6410a906b0fc71395d09c0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2da6b51282ca78f6dbdc59d5f222ffc91e992122cf5f1c41dbe03cca2105a500.png] **Option (2): PXR**
